title: Verify deleting a customer removes that customer's default links
custom_preconds: 1. A disposable ZZAUTOTEST customer has at least 1 default fee/discount linked.
custom_steps:
1. Delete a ZZAUTOTEST customer.
2. Confirm the templates that were its defaults still exist in Administration → Service → Fees & Discounts.
custom_expected:
1. The customer and its default links are removed.
2. The location templates are not deleted (only the customer's links go away).
